code='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the most varied repeated tile to every matching tile position."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x: out.append((start, x))

        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rb, cb = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)

            tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            score=(len({v for row in tile for v in row}), sum(v != 0 for row in tile for v in row))
            tiles.append((score,ri,ci,tile))

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    th,tw=len(template),len(template[0])

            if r1-r0==th and c1-c0==tw:
                for dr in range(th):
